skills.title: Tech Stack
description: My approach to modern development revolves around several high-performance ecosystems. I use the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express, React, Node.js) to design full-fledged, dynamic web apps leveraging a 100% JavaScript-based toolkit.

For mobile development, I rely on Flutter, Google's powerful mobile framework based on Dart. It is a real game-changer for building fluid, cross-platform apps (iOS and Android) tailored for any screen.

Finally, I also master robust infrastructures like the LAMP/LEMP stack (Linux, Nginx/Apache, MySQL/PostgreSQL), providing a secure server environment that significantly speeds up the development and deployment process.
